description: This file contains the implementation of utility functions for the Slap Access Manager object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It includes a function to create a new access manager object, primarily serving as a wrapper around the SlapAmoCreate function.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapCreateAccessManager(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Slap Access Manager object using the provided container, owner, and reserved handles.
